prompt: "The wooden wheel runs (quietly) than the plastic one, so our daughter can sleep."

prompt: My electric rice cooker works (fast) than my grandmother's heavy iron pot.

prompt: Although the wide rain tank costs extra at first, Pilar believes it saves (much / water) than thin hoses during dry summer winds.

prompt: "Which of these two paint colours makes our small bedroom look (bright)?"
explanation_ru: Выбор делается между двумя цветами (these two), поэтому даже без than нужна сравнительная степень brighter.

prompt: I didn't book the Saturday musical because the Friday puppet show seemed (suitable) for my young niece than a long play.
explanation_ru: Сравниваются два спектакля с союзом than, поэтому многосложное прилагательное suitable требует сравнительной степени more suitable.

prompt: Liwei walked past eight noodle stalls and found (hot) curry in town.
explanation_ru: Выбор идёт среди восьми лавок и по всему городу (in town), поэтому нужна превосходная степень с артиклем — the hottest.

prompt: Jan tried on nine pairs of glasses and picked (light) pair of all.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о выборе из девяти оправ (of all), поэтому используется превосходная степень с артиклем — the lightest.

prompt: Duncan's parents didn't choose the evening history walk because the steep stone steps looked (bad) for their knees than the flat museum floors.
explanation_ru: Сравниваются два варианта экскурсии с союзом than, поэтому исключение bad ставится в сравнительную степень — worse.

prompt: Hannah and Leo booked the garden room because it had (little / noise) than the balcony room.
explanation_ru: Сравниваются два номера с than, а существительное noise неисчисляемое, поэтому используется форма less noise.

prompt: Jules knows the night-shift hotel bakery pays (well) than the corner shop, but he prefers the short walk and the friendly team near his flat.
explanation_ru: Сравниваются две пекарни с союзом than; наречие well — исключение и образует сравнительную степень better.

prompt: "Look at those six paper planes — which one flew (far) across the hall?"
explanation_ru: Соревнуются шесть самолётиков (больше двух), поэтому нужна превосходная степень наречия far — the furthest (или the farthest).

prompt: Rita watched five gentle shelter dogs on the lawn to see which one behaved (calmly) beside her young child.
explanation_ru: Выбирают одну собаку из пяти, поэтому наречие calmly ставится в превосходную степень — the most calmly (или most calmly).

prompt: Bram didn't rent (cheap) room on the student housing website because it barely had enough space for a single bed and a kettle.
explanation_ru: Речь о самой дешёвой комнате среди всех вариантов на сайте, поэтому требуется превосходная степень с артиклем — the cheapest.

prompt: We checked six grassy spots in the pine forest and pitched our tent on (dry) ground of all.
explanation_ru: Выбор делается из шести мест (of all), поэтому короткое прилагательное dry образует превосходную степень the driest.

prompt: Sabine wanted to enjoy the main painting gallery without rushing. She didn't join the guided tour because the guide spoke (loudly) than she liked. With a free audio guide, she could move (slowly) through the halls than in a big group. In the end, the quiet portrait room felt like (peaceful) corner in the whole museum.
explanation_ru: В первых двух пропусках есть сравнение с than (наречия more loudly, more slowly), а в третьем выделяется один уголок во всём музее (in the whole museum) — the most peaceful.

prompt: Tobias laughed when he checked the seat map at the Vienna concert hall. The pricey front seats stood behind a thick stone pillar, so visitors there saw the musicians (badly) than people upstairs. Surprisingly, the cheap balcony sounded (good) than the front row and gave (wide) view in the whole hall. He wasn't going to pay extra only to stare at stone all evening.
explanation_ru: В первых двух случаях сравниваются две зоны с than (исключения worse и better), а в третьем — лучший обзор во всём зале (in the whole hall), поэтому the widest.

prompt: Lara held up a brown leather jacket and a green raincoat at the market. "Which one keeps you (dry) in autumn rain?" she asked her friend. The green raincoat cost (little / money) than the leather jacket, too. She bought the raincoat and walked home smiling.
explanation_ru: В обоих пропусках сравниваются две вещи (куртка и плащ), поэтому нужны сравнительные формы drier и less money.

prompt: Javier and Lucia needed to practise for Sunday's local tennis match. The ball always bounces (high) on the red clay court than on the hard court, so points last longer. However, the hard court lets players run (fast) and suits their quick style. Of all four courts at the club, court two stays (busy) on weekday evenings.
explanation_ru: Сначала сравниваются два типа покрытия (higher, faster), а в последнем предложении выбирается один корт из четырёх (of all four), поэтому нужна превосходная степень the busiest.

prompt: I packed my bag carefully before recording street interviews on a breezy afternoon. My heavy desk microphone captures voices (clearly) indoors than the tiny shirt clip, though it is awkward to carry. Outside, the small clip works (easily) in strong wind and keeps my hands free. Among all the gear in my small room, that cheap clip has become (useful) tool I own.
explanation_ru: Первые два пропуска сравнивают два микрофона (more clearly, more easily), а третий выделяет один прибор среди всего оборудования (among all), поэтому the most useful.

prompt: "Should we really drive in this heavy rain?" Kirsty asked near Edinburgh. Gavin checked his phone and saw that the coastal train was (slow) than driving on a normal day. Today, though, roadworks blocked two lanes, so the train arrived (early) than any car could. It wasn't (direct) route to their meeting, so they walked five minutes from the station.
explanation_ru: В первых двух пропусках поезд сравнивается с машиной через than (slower, earlier), а в третьем оценивается самый прямой маршрут среди всех возможных — the most direct.

prompt: Dark storm clouds gathered over the water as Alan and Brenda stood at the Wellington ferry terminal. Taking the earlier boat looked (risky) than booking a short flight, because rough waves often cancel crossings. The plane tickets cost (much / money) than the ferry passes, which bothered Alan at first. Still, the small plane crossed the bay (safely) of all the evening services that night.
explanation_ru: Сначала сравниваются два вида транспорта с than (riskier, more money), а в конце выбирается самый безопасный рейс среди всех вечерних (of all) — the most safely.

prompt: Cian and Paula had a big drawing project due on Friday. They left the sunny top floor because they worked (hard) in the quiet basement. With no phone signal downstairs, they sent (few / messages) than upstairs and finished on time. Both students went home happy.
explanation_ru: Сравниваются два этажа библиотеки, поэтому для глагола work нужна сравнительная степень harder, а с исчисляемым messages — fewer messages.

prompt: Hi Marc, I checked five surf camps near our hotel in Biarritz this morning. Blue Wave Camp sits (close) to our rooms of all five, so the teenagers can walk there easily. Their coaches explain safety rules (carefully) than the harbour team, and they charge (reasonable) price in town. I'll book their morning lessons before the places fill up.
explanation_ru: Первый и третий пропуски выделяют один лагерь из пяти и по городу (the closest, the most reasonable), а второй сравнивает две команды инструкторов через than (more carefully).

prompt: "Is the shady climbing tower ___ for us than the sunny football pitch?"
explanation_ru: Сравниваются два места с союзом than, поэтому нужна форма cooler; вариант more cooler — частая ошибка двойной сравнительной степени.

prompt: Please look at all four painted wall designs outside the corner shop and vote for ___ one of all.
explanation_ru: Выбор идёт из четырёх рисунков (of all), поэтому нужна превосходная степень the brightest, без лишнего слова most.

prompt: Eszter opened six beginner baking books and bought the one with ___ bread photos.
explanation_ru: Выбирается одна книга из шести, поэтому требуется превосходная степень с артиклем the clearest, а не сравнительная the clearer.

prompt: After sitting on seven display armchairs in the showroom, Alessio realised that the green wooden model supported his grandmother's back ___ of all.
explanation_ru: Речь о семи креслах (of all) и о том, как кресло поддерживает спину, поэтому нужна превосходная степень наречия — the most firmly.

prompt: "Can you tell me which of these eight paper dragon masks has ___ smile for Saturday's show?"
explanation_ru: Масок восемь, поэтому нужна превосходная степень с определённым артиклем — the funniest; типичная ошибка — опускать the или ставить the funnier.

prompt: Watching the fishing boats beside the pier, Defne didn't order the red lentil soup because the grilled sea bass smelled ___ the soup.
explanation_ru: Сравниваются два блюда, поэтому нужна форма better than; частые ошибки — путать than с then или писать more good.

answer: Here are five small card games — which one is the best for our trip?

Here are five small card games — which one is best for our trip?

prompt: Graham prefers a late-afternoon clinic slot because the waiting room is more quieter than at eight.

accepted_answers: Graham prefers a late-afternoon clinic slot because the waiting room is quieter than at eight.

answer: Morag read six local job adverts and chose the company that offered the most holiday days.

prompt: I tried two overnight buses to Arequipa, and the green coach didn't feel warmer then the blue one when we crossed the mountains.
answer: I tried two overnight buses to Arequipa, and the green coach didn't feel warmer than the blue one when we crossed the mountains.

prompt: Kenji checked eight earbud cases in the shop. Case C weighed the least.
